nodes.description: An engraved wedding ring that emerged from The Fog and resonates with an indescribable and incomprehensible energy. The Obsession and yourself both see each other's aura at all times.Decreases your chances to be The Killer’s Obsession.

nodes.label: Unknown Egg
nodes.description:
A large, warm egg coated in gruesome webbing.

Decreases the cooldown after traversing the Upside Down by 2.5 seconds.

nodes.label: Untitled Agony
nodes.description:
A canvas that was targeted with swipes and thrashes of black paint following Matias' death. It radiates with heavy, crippling sorrow.When Dire Crows swarm a Survivor, it afflicts them with a 15% Hindered status effect for 1.5 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

nodes.label: Unusual Stamp
nodes.description:
A wooden stamp with a crosshatched rubber pad used to mark documents. It is unclear as to how or by whom this stamp was originally used. Can be used with a Map.

Increases the range of the Map tracking ability by 8 meters.

nodes.label: Upside Down Resin
nodes.description: A sticky, flammable sap that fortifies the gateway to the interdimensional tunnels.Increases time required for Survivors to seal Portals by 20%.

nodes.label: Uroboros Tendril
nodes.description: The result of decades of Bio Organic Weapon research. It will not rest until it has swallowed the entire world.Increases movement speed while charging Virulent Bound by 5%.

nodes.label: Uroboros Virus
nodes.description: For some, the strength and resistance was worth the trade-off.When a Survivor reaches full infection, reveal their aura for 4 seconds.

nodes.label: Utility Blades
nodes.description:
A modification to the Reverse Bear Trap: Sharp blades attached to the trap's interior lacerate the victim with every movement.

Reverse Bear Traps inflict Hemorrhage every time the Survivor is injured by any means.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

nodes.label: VCR
nodes.description:
The original VCR that played Sadako's tape. It is still warm to the touch.

All TVs play the Projection effects when The Onryō Projects to a TV.

nodes.label: VHS Porn
nodes.description:
An all time classic. You won't see things quite the same again.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by 10%.

nodes.label: Valtiel Sect Photograph
nodes.description: A photograph of two figures in red hoods. Entitled Crimson and White Banquet for the Gods.Decreases your Terror Radius by 2 meters for each Survivor affected by Torment.

nodes.label: Vanishing Box
nodes.description:
The magician was popular at children’s parties, and quickly became the top suspect.

Survivors who complete generators become Weakened against UVX.Increases Hallucination spawn time by 120%.

Weakened Survivors lose health states when hit by the UVX's Blast Area.

nodes.label: Vanity Mirror
nodes.description:
A standing portable vanity mirror in perfect condition except for a fine layer of dust and face powder covering it.

When Evil Incarnate ends, you see the auras of all Survivors for 4 seconds.

nodes.label: Vegetable Oil
nodes.description:
A rancid oil used as a poor quality lubricant.

Decreases Chainsaw cooldown by 0.3 seconds.

nodes.label: Velvet Fabric
nodes.description:
A striking red fabric Carmina used on an art project. Its brightness contrasted against black feathers.

When a Survivor attempts to repel a Dire Crow swarm, the swarm's aura remains visible for an additional 1.5 seconds.

nodes.label: Venomous Concoction
nodes.description:
A toxic concoction applied to the Hatchets' blade. The murky concoction is mainly composed of Berus snake venom which gives it fatiguing capabilities.

Hatchets inflict Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

nodes.label: Vermillion Webcap
nodes.description:
A bright red poisonous mushroom from the Upside Down.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable effect gained when emerging from a Portal by 3 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

nodes.label: Vibrant Obituary
nodes.description:
Scrap newspaper, speckled with bright, eye-catching paint. It seems tragedy is a daily thing.

Increases the length of time a Dire Crow's Killer Instinct reveals Survivors by 3 seconds.

Killer Instinct intermittently reveals the location of Survivors.

nodes.label: Victim’s Detailed Routine
nodes.description:
A ripped page outlining the weekly routine of Olsen's first victim in Roseville. Compiling your victim's habits allows you to anticipate and counter their next move.

After being Marked, Survivors are inflicted with Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

nodes.label: Victim’s Map
nodes.description:
He thought the key to solving the mystery lay beyond the forest, and feared he would never return.

When a Survivor successfully Stares Down The Unknown, The Unknown gains Killer Instinct for 3 seconds.

nodes.label: Victor's Razor Blade
nodes.description:
In his grief, Henry's father used a hidden blade to take out his own eyes.

When Worldbreaker Mode ends, injured Survivors become afflicted with the Broken status effect for the next 20 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

nodes.label: Victor’s Soldier
nodes.description:
A toy soldier Victor clung to when scared. Something about it evoked jealousy in Charlotte.

Crushing Victor while he is dormant reveals the Survivor's aura for 6 seconds.

nodes.label: Video Conference Device
nodes.description: Many intricate conspiracies were orchestrated on devices just like this one.Increases the Infection passive gain rate by 30%.

nodes.label: Video Tape
nodes.description:
A recording of Jigsaw, explaining the game's rules to Amanda. Reminiscing about her past-self hardens her determination.

Survivors begin the trial with Reverse Bear Traps installed.

nodes.label: Videotape Copy
nodes.description:
A copy of the deadly videotape imprinted upon by Sadako. It dampens the desire for vengeance.

Increases the range at which Survivors gain Condemned from Projection by 2 meters

nodes.label: Vigo's Journal
nodes.description:
The journal of a man who claimed to have returned from the Void. The knowledge within has practical applications.

Grants Undetectable while Rushing.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, terror radius and red stain.

nodes.label: Vile Emetic
nodes.description:
A foul-smelling and half-congealed potion of unidentifiable ingredients. Consumed to rapidly induce vomiting. Used to purge evil from the body.

Increases velocity of vomit projectiles by 10%.

nodes.label: Violet Waxcap
nodes.description:
A dark fleshed mushroom from the Upside Down that allows The Demogorgon to telepathically distort the senses in its prey.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable effect gained when emerging from a Portal by 1 second.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

nodes.label: Viscous Webbing
nodes.description: Wet, elastic webs that broaden the interdimensional tunnels.Increases time required for Survivors to seal Portals by 10%.

nodes.label: Visitor Wristband
nodes.description: An electronic Umbrella wristband for visitors to the facility. It also doubles as a tracking device.Increases zombie detection range by 2 meters and field of view by 10 degrees.

nodes.label: Vital Targeting Processor
nodes.description:
An additional process in the drone’s programming more accurately predicts the weaknesses of potential prey.

Increases the Hindered status effect gained by Claw Trapped Survivors when detected by a Drone by 2%. Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

nodes.label: Volcanic Stone
nodes.description:
The heat of its birthplace glows within this living rock.

Decreases the Fog Vial cooldown by 5 seconds.

nodes.label: Vorpal Sword
nodes.description:
A powerful magical artifact whose blade has severed many a head from its accompanying body.

Any injured Survivor that enters a Dispelling Sphere screams and gains Broken for 30 seconds.Whenever you cast Mage Hand on a dropped Pallet, after 4 seconds, it special-breaks.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

nodes.label: Waiting for You Watch
nodes.description:
A pocket watch worn by Ji-woon during a live performance of I’ll Be Waiting for You. It’s a stage prop that doesn’t work and never will.

Survivors whose Laceration Meter fully decays are revealed for 10 seconds.

nodes.label: Wakizashi Saya
nodes.description:
The scabbard of an ancestral blade. Once crafted for the Yamaoka family.

During Yamaoka's Haunting, use the Active Ability Button to return to the husk and end the haunting.

nodes.label: Walleye's Matchbook
nodes.description:
A sheet of matches from Walleye's, a small bar in Northern Roseville. A victim’s phone number is scribbled in blue. One of the incriminating pieces of evidence found.

Decreases Night Shroud recovery time by 2 seconds.

nodes.label: Wanted Poster
nodes.description:
The yellowed remains of a wanted poster for Mason Kelly. Kept Caleb focused on the hunt.

Increases movement speed by 3% while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

nodes.label: War Helmet
nodes.description:
While investigating an Overlap in the Alps, she found an abandoned war bunker. She took a helmet from it after the Overlap nearly took her.

Increases Killer Instinct duration by 1.5 seconds.

nodes.label: Warden’s Keys
nodes.description:
The dull jangle of the keys evokes a furious memory within Caleb.

Decreases The Redeemer's reload time by 0.35 seconds.

nodes.label: Warg’s Fang
nodes.description:
A mighty tool of destruction taken from one of Dracula’s most dangerous allies.

Reveals the auras of all Survivors whose Scent Orbs you have collected whenever Pounce Attack becomes available for 5 seconds.

nodes.label: Waterlogged Shoe
nodes.description:
A child's shoe, long lost in the bog's waters. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Survivors in the trigger zone of a triggered Phantasm Trap are Hindered by 9%.Increases movement speed by 7.5%.Removes the ability to teleport to traps.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

nodes.label: Waterskin
nodes.description:
She gave him the last of her water, knowing he needed the strength to hunt.

Increases the Dog's Chase redirect distance by 20%.

nodes.label: Wax Brick
nodes.description:
A block of wax used to lower friction and facilitate movement in mechanical parts.

Increases the time required to rescue a Survivor or attempt escape from a Bear Trap by 33%.

nodes.label: Wax Doll
nodes.description: A doll carved from wax, handcrafted by a prisoner who would soon face their judgment.Increases the range of Punishment of the Damned by 5%.

nodes.label: Weaved Ring
nodes.description:
A mundane key ring in appearance with an unusual bluish dark sheen. The ring binds the Key to the user, preventing its loss even in the darkest of times.

Do not lose the Key on death, lose this add-on instead.

nodes.label: Weighted Head
nodes.description:
An oddly weighted hatchet head, crafted to deliver a hard blow to its target. It requires a wielder with a strong arm.

Hatchets inflict Incapacitated for 10 seconds.

Incapacitated prevents Survivors from healing, repairing, sabotaging, cleansing, blessing, mending, or using items.

nodes.label: Weighty Rattle
nodes.description:
A shoddily carved rattle that Victor cried over until his mother stole it for him. It’s entirely too heavy to be trusted to a child.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Broken for 20 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

nodes.label: Well Stone
nodes.description:
A piece of the well where Sadako was trapped, an image burned into the mind of all those who have watched the tape.

Decreases the time it takes for a TV to turn on after being turned off by a Survivor by 7 seconds.

nodes.label: Well Water
nodes.description:
Water from the well where Sadako was left to die. Murky and black, it obscures everything around it.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable status effect by 2 seconds when Manifesting by any means.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

nodes.label: White Hair Ribbon
nodes.description:
A silken bow to tame wild hair.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting charge speed by 20%.

nodes.label: White Nit Comb
nodes.description:
A parasitic nit comb taken from the clinic. Once the symbol of a deep connection between an anxious patient and her nurse.

Decreases the length of Blink Attack lunges by 50%.Increases Bloodpoints for Blink Attack score events by 100%.

nodes.label: White Wolf Medallion
nodes.description:
A trinket once used to call a great spirit guide.

Increases Killer Instinct duration by 1 second while in Wolf Form after Survivors complete rushed actions.

nodes.label: Wide Lens
nodes.description:
A thin wide lens in perfect condition. Designed to spread the Flashlight beam at the cost of reducing its range of effectiveness.

Decreases the range of the Flashlight beam by 25%.Increases the width of the Flashlight beam by 25%.

nodes.label: Willow Wreath
nodes.description:
Three frail willow branches attached to form a triangular wreath.

Reveals the Survivor's aura for 5 seconds when they trigger a Phantasm Trap.

nodes.label: Winged Boots
nodes.description:
Long used by their wearers to move quickly.

Increases maximum distance of Teleport by 20%.

nodes.label: Wire Spool
nodes.description:
A portable but heavy spool of copper wire.

Adds 12 charges to the Toolbox.

nodes.label: Wooden Fox
nodes.description:
Roughly carved, this fox statuette is no more than a few inches. A reminder that stealth and cunning is as effective as raw power.

Grants Undetectable for 30 seconds after reloading.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

nodes.label: Wooden Horse
nodes.description:
An unpainted toy carved out of cheap wood to resemble a horse. Once the symbol of a deep connection between a catatonic patient and his nurse.

Decreases extra fatigue from missed Blink Attacks by 50%.

nodes.label: Wooden Oni Mask
nodes.description:
A mask that a young Kazan bought to celebrate Setsubun, its repulsively fanged mouth began haunting his nightmares.

Increases the frequency of Blood Orbs dropped by Survivors by 14%.Survivors drop an additional Blood Orb when they vault, throw pallets, exit lockers, crouch, or fail a skill check.

nodes.label: Wooden Plank
nodes.description:
A wooden plank torn from the stage where Otto Stamper sacrificed a meddling journalist.

Increases the amount Nightfall charges when a Survivor is hooked by 25%.

nodes.label: Wool Shirt
nodes.description:
A small boy's orange and yellow striped shirt. Identified with a sewn name tag to "Jesse".

Decreases the delay before Dream Pallets rupture by 10%.

nodes.label: Workshop Grease
nodes.description:
A simple tube of grease, used to lubricate the mechanisms of the hidden blade.

Increases Ambush attack charge speed by 50%.

nodes.label: Worry Stone
nodes.description:
While the Ottomarians were told to think only positive thoughts, some kept these stones in their pockets to rub when negative thoughts arose.

Reveals the aura of a Survivor for 6 seconds when they lock a locker.

nodes.label: Worship Tablet
nodes.description:
A stone tablet adorned with gold showing the drawings and writings of a corrupted incantation used originally to worship forgotten deities.

Increases speed of ingesting corruption at a Pool of Devotion by 100%.Increases movement speed while holding Corrupt Purge by 4.5%.

nodes.label: Wriggling Maggots
nodes.description:
Larvae that poured from the mouth of a corpse hidden in the Cotton household.

Increases turn rate of possessed chains by 15%.

nodes.label: Wriggling Parasite
nodes.description:
A fragile organism that has an unusual effect on its host.

Increases the passive growth rate to Leeched II by 16%.

nodes.label: Yakuyoke Amulet
nodes.description:
A powerful talisman to protect your endeavors from being hindered by suspicious circumstances.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting duration by 70%.Decreases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 15%.

nodes.label: Yamaoka Sashimono
nodes.description:
The banner of the Yamaoka family, Kazan felt an overwhelming pride from it.

Increases Blood Fury duration by 8 seconds.

nodes.label: Yamori’s Mask
nodes.description:
Worn by a ghoul from the 13th district whose hobby was torture.

Upon hooking a Survivor while in Enraged Mode, all Survivors further than 40 meters scream and reveal their location for 3 seconds.

nodes.label: Yardstick
nodes.description:
Good for measuring distance. Even better for laying down a beating.

A Scamper reveals Survivor auras within 16 meters of you for 3 seconds.

nodes.label: Yellow Wire
nodes.description:
A small electrical wire. Both ends are heavily damaged like it has been forcefully torn out of its intended location. Can be tied around a Map to enhance its aura reading ability.

Unlocks the ability to track exit gates.

nodes.label: Yellowed Cloth
nodes.description:
A simple scrap of material to tend to blisters and wipe the puss away.

Increases thrown hatchet speed by 10%.

nodes.label: Yoichi's Fishing Net
nodes.description:
The net Yoichi used while fishing with his grandfather. A reminder that death comes to us all.

Survivors with at least 4 stacks of Condemned suffer from Blindness.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

nodes.label: Young Coconut
nodes.description:
Her first meal as a castaway, she shared it with her loyal companion.

Increases the Dog's Chase speed by 5%.

nodes.label: Zombie Heart
nodes.description: The heart of an eviscerated zombie. It’s considered hazardous waste as it’s certainly teeming with viruses.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 75%.

nodes.label: Zōri
nodes.description:
A comfortable pair of flat sandals that can easily be slipped on and off.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 5%.

nodes.label: “Ghost Face Caught on Tape”
nodes.description:
Tape obtained by Olsen to write an article that terrorized Roseville.

Instantly recharges Night Shroud after a successful basic attack that puts a Survivor into the dying state.

nodes.label: “Philly”
nodes.description:
Stolen camera from a victim of Olsen’s in Philadelphia, where he worked before. The film inside captured his last night in the city.

Decreases time required to Mark a Survivor by 10%.
